result.markdown:
# Transport Failure on LNK-SAH-01-A Causing Outage for S-SAH-002

- **Classification:** incident
- **Root cause:** transport_failure at `LNK-SAH-01-A`
- **Confidence:** medium (Direct evidence of LINK_LOS on the parent fiber link matching the exact start of the site outages, with changes and maintenance explicitly checked and ruled out. External events were NOT CHECKED via tool calls.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-29 05:00 to 2026-09-29 08:11
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-29 05:03
- **Affected:** S-SAH-002, S-SAH-004, S-SAH-012

## Summary

A fiber link loss on LNK-SAH-01-A caused a total site outage for S-SAH-002 and its sibling sites.

S-SAH-002 experienced an outage starting at 05:00 on 2026-09-29 and recovered when the link alarm cleared at 08:11.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-29 05:00: Anomaly detector alerts and metric drops begin for S-SAH-002 and sibling sites. [T1, ANM-000472, ANM-000473, ANM-000474, ALR-0038]
- 2026-09-29 05:03: Critical LINK_LOS alarm raised on parent fiber link LNK-SAH-01-A. [T3, ALM-000589]
- 2026-09-29 05:04: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised for S-SAH-002, S-SAH-004, and S-SAH-012. [T3, ALM-000590, ALM-000591, ALM-000592]
- 2026-09-29 08:08: LINK_LOS alarm cleared on LNK-SAH-01-A. [T3, ALM-000589]
- 2026-09-29 08:11: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared for S-SAH-002 and S-SAH-004. [T3, ALM-000590, ALM-000592]

## Evidence

- S-SAH-002 availability and performance metrics dropped starting around 2026-09-29 05:00. [T1, ANM-000472, ANM-000473, ANM-000474]
- S-SAH-002 topology chain routes through LNK-SAH-01-A and AGG-SAH-01. [T2, S-SAH-002]
- A critical LINK_LOS occurred on LNK-SAH-01-A at 2026-09-29 05:03, causing SITE_DOWN alarms on S-SAH-002 and sibling sites S-SAH-004 and S-SAH-012 at 2026-09-29 05:04. [T3, ALM-000589, ALM-000590, ALM-000591, ALM-000592]
- No changes were performed on S-SAH-002 or its parents during the incident window. [T4]
- No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SAH-002 or its parents during the incident window. [T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **transport_failure** at LNK-SAH-01-A: confirmed. Directly evidenced by the critical LINK_LOS alarm on the parent fiber link occurring right before simultaneous SITE_DOWN alarms across all child sites. [T3, ALM-000589]
2. **bad_change** at S-SAH-002: rejected. No configuration changes were found on S-SAH-002 or its parent nodes during the time window. [T4]
3. **planned_maintenance** at S-SAH-002: rejected. No maintenance windows were scheduled on S-SAH-002 or its parent nodes during the time window. [T5]

## Ruled out

- T4: Rule out bad configuration changes as no changes occurred on the node or its ancestors.
- T5: Rule out scheduled maintenance as no maintenance windows were active.

## Recommended actions

- Inspect the physical fiber link LNK-SAH-01-A to determine the root cause of the loss of signal (LINK_LOS).

## Sources

- `T1`: get_anomalies(start=2026-09-29 03:05, end=2026-09-29 08:17, entity_id=S-SAH-002) -> 1 detector alert(s) overlap 2026-09-29 03:05 to 2026-09-29 08:17 (1 still ongoing at asked_at 2026-09-29 08:17).
